Ruling: Keep the existing isolated b200 worktree and branch feature/ui-reorganization from committed idle feature 9ee8dac — avoids a second worktree and preserves approved feature APIs — wrong branch choice would complicate integration but not behavior.

Ruling: Reconnect chip stays visible through connecting/preparing retries of the same device, resets on device identity change — RobotLink cycles these states during recovery — if wrong, an initial connection could be mislabeled; covered by sequence tests.

Ruling: Sleeping suppresses user-pause and looking chips but preserves neck and heat warnings — only pause priority is specified, while BLE remains active — if wrong, extra warning chips would be visible during standby.

Ruling: Initial-start single-call assertion applies to repeated active notifications and permission-prompt inactivity; ordinary background return still starts capture again — preserves existing lifecycle semantics — if wrong, background recovery could remain silent.

Ruling: Display paused chip for audio interruption and route-change pauses as well as user tap — existing audio behavior requires tap to resume and the new screen otherwise hides that fact — if omitted, users could see an apparently listening cat while microphone is stopped. Rename flag to isAwaitingTapToResume / showsTapToResume, chip to .paused. New audio test observed 8 failed assertions before fix.

Ruling: Reconnect chip requires previous connected state for the same device — initial saved-device timeout retries must stay silent — hasConnected resets on unselected/device change, survives suspended/searching/unavailable. New retry regression is being verified.
Ruling: Commit Tasks 2 and 3 together because both own AppRootView and tests were verified together — avoids artificial partial-file staging — no behavior or scope changes.

Ruling: Expose available reply text as default-importance custom content on the cat after completion/stop; preserve existing announcement policy — real voice/typed completion routes through thinking, so removing captions otherwise removes manual full-text access — if wrong, reply may be unavailable in an overlooked phase; all resting/paused/failed phases and sleeping/streaming suppression covered by regression tests.

Final: Ruling: Unchanged engine, motion, camera and idle internals remain the reviewed baseline; iPad is outside the approved scope — this task changes presentation and startup integration — real keyboard/VoiceOver/robot acceptance remains unverified and is explicitly recorded.
